fig5_scope.heatmap_uncertainty: Cell means; conditional 95% intervals for every cell are in hotset_scan_summary.csv. Markers are descriptive, not equivalence tests.

supp_deadlines.bands: Conditional percentile 95% bootstrap intervals, 10000 resamples; policies share seeds and arrivals. 500 ms retained in source data.

supp_nearties.normalization: 100 * (W_runnerup - W_best) / (N*q); six policies, mean counts over 30 traces
supp_nearties.uncertainty: Deterministic mean-cost surfaces; tolerance is not a statistical equivalence margin.
